item.title: Why Winners Can Look More Skilled Than They Are
item.description: Selection, survival, and reinforcement change what success can tell us. Synthetic demonstrations and experimental evidence expose the limits of learning from winners.

item.title: What Can Statistics Mean by Luck?
item.description: Being surprised and being fortunate are different judgments. A statistical account of luck must examine the reference distribution, the opportunities observed, and the boundary around control.
